title: 4 What are the duties of married perſons.

segments.text: THE duties of married perſons, are, 1 Mutuall Loue, 2 Spouſall faith & troth, as each to loue the other only, continually and conſtantly. 3 Communitie of goods, and a Sympathie or fellow-feeling in euils and calamities. 4 The bringing foorth, and bringing vp of children. 5 Bearing with infirmities, with a deſire to cure them. The proper duety of the huſband is, 1 To nouriſh his wiſe, and children. 2 To gouerne them. 3 To defend them. The proper duety of the wife is, 1 To be a helper vnto her husband in maintaining and preſeruing their houſhold ſubſtance. 2 To obey and reuerence her husband. When theſe thinges are neglected, they grieuouſlie treſpaſſe againſt the lawful vſe of marriage.
